p.s: There are many ways we can choose in our trip.
There are two major and popular ways for trip.
One is travel in a group led by a tour guide, the other is travel by oneself.
In my opoinion, I do n't agree with the following statement about "The best way to travel is in a group led by a tour guide."
I have travelled in a different places since I was a child.
I travelled both in a group led by a tour guide and by myself.
During these experience, I disagree with the following statement about "The best way to travel is in a group led by a tour guide."
There are some reasons and examples to support my answer as follows.
In my opinion, first, it 's waste time to travel is in a group led by a tour guide.
Many people will choose to travel is in a group led by a tour guide, becasuse they think it 's safe, especially they are in a foreign countries.
But, I think too many people will waste many time.
Because different people have different interests, travelling is in a group led by a tour guide, they ca n't make all of you feel the trip is just for you.
Sometimes travelling is in a group led by a tour guide will guide you to visit some places which are unnecessary or you do n't like.
Because travel agency ca n't satifify all of you.
The second reason to support my answer is it 's waste money.
When you join in a group led by a tour guide.
It is certain they can arrange all your plan in a trip totally and you do n't have to worry many things.
But they will ask you to give them extra fee and tips in many ways.
Third and last reason is you do n't have free and flexible time.
As for me, I went to foreign country for studying for one month by meself.
Although I 'm not good at the language, comparing with other people I had much more free time and learned many things in travel by myself.
I have many different experiences in traveling.
This is way I disagree "The best way to travel is in a group led by a tour guide."
